fix(telemetry): only follow the client's explicit serverURL for dedicated-mode traces (#289)

* fix(telemetry): only follow the client's explicit serverURL for dedicated-mode traces

Named eu/us servers keep exporting to api.mistral.ai since the regional
hosts don't serve /telemetry/v1/traces, and path prefixes on serverURL
are now preserved.

* test(telemetry): install optional OpenTelemetry SDK packages as dev dependencies

The dedicated telemetry endpoint tests load @opentelemetry/sdk-trace-base and
@opentelemetry/resources for real. They are optional peer dependencies, which
npm install doesn't pull in, so the tests failed in CI. Users still don't need
to install
